newsitem.title: HAITI: Haitians hack Dominican soldier to death.
newsitem.headline: Haitians hack Dominican soldier to death.

text.p: Migrant Haitian workers hacked a Dominican Republic soldier to death at a farm near the tense border between the two countries, Dominican diplomats said on Tuesday.
Cpl. Adames Portes was killed on Sunday in the Dominican province of Elias Pina, they said. Haitian peasants working on the farm attacked him with their machetes.
A Haitian radio report said they seized his gun and chopped off an arm before killing him.
The diplomats were unable to give more details but the incident occurred at a time of heightened tensions between the two neighbours over the republic's forced repatriation of Haitians.
Over the past two months up to 14,000 Haitians have been sent home while those left fear they will be forced back soon.
"The situation is hot but I believe the two governments are doing their best to work it out," a Haitian Foreign Ministry official said on Tuesday.

The Dominican diplomats said they did not believe Portes' murder was linked to the repatriations since Presidents Rene Preval of Haiti and Leonel Fernandez of the Dominican Republic met last week and halted the policy.
